Complete the four sub-quests to get your Assassin Insignia.
 
==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| profession = Assassin 
| primary = y
| campaign = factions
}}

===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Instructor Ng]].
* Complete the [[Advanced Defense Techniques]] course.
* Complete the [[Disenchantment Course]].
* Complete the [[Skill Chaining|Skill Chaining]] Course.
* Complete the [[Snaring Course]].
* See [[Headmaster Lee]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 75 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
This quest requires the completion of four sub-quests given also by Instructor Ng. The order of completion is entirely optional.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Headmaster Lee
''You are ready to earn your Assassin Insignia? All right, then. This advanced training is designed to teach you the nuances of the Assassin's art. An Assassin is an intensive damage-dealer who relies on the powers of shadow and steel. By using potent magic to sneak up on enemies and powerful skill combinations to deal deadly attacks, an Assassin can quickly overcome a foe. Speak with '''Instructor Ng''' to begin your training.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I am ready to earn my Assassin Insignia.
| decline = I am not ready yet.
| ask = It was my understanding that you wished to become an expert Assassin. Speak with '''Instructor Ng''' to begin training for your Assassin Insignia.

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Lee
''Congratulations. You have earned your Assassin Insignia. You are now an expert Assassin. May the gods guide and protect you.''
